about_the_game:
"Embark!" on a tactical roguelite adventure in Lavender Field Crusaders! Retro graphics meet fast-paced in-depth combat that rewards clever positioning and creative synergies. Lead your team through procedurally generated runs, combining abilities and terrain for devastating effects.

Master Tactical Combat!

Create water at your enemies' feet and strike with lightning for electrifying takedowns.

Pair a simple firebolt with grease spells to ignite an inferno!

Push foes off cliffs or use the environment to turn the tide - every move counts on the battlefield.

Build Your Diverse Team!

Field a squad from a collection of unique character classes, each boasting many of dozens of unique abilities and upgrades!

Customize with items that transform gameplay, enabling new strategies beyond mere stat boosts.

Explore Varied Biomes!

Navigate distinct encounter maps that alter your approach - trudge through murky swamps, or blast through abandoned mine tunnels.

Battle Unique Foes!

Face off against possessed cultists, infectious zombie hordes, dividing slimes, and more in thrilling, unpredictable encounters.

With retro charm and hours of replayability, assemble your adventurers, harness synergies, and conquer the dungeon depths!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / macOS 10.9 / Ubuntu 14.04 or equivalent
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1 compatible, integrated graphics (Intel HD 3000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / macOS 10.12 / Ubuntu 18.04 or newer
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0+ compatible, any dedicated GPU or modern integrated graphics
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
